camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/createTenantDirectory --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'name=示例名称.pdf' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Creates a root directory or subdirectory for an enterprise knowledge base in the current tenant, and configures digital employee associations and AI version summaries for standard enterprise roots
description_zh: 在当前租户创建企业知识库根目录或子目录，并可为普通企业根配置数字员工关联和 AI 版本摘要
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo create-tenant-directory --name '示例名称.pdf' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTenantDirectory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target tenant. It is used for tenant routing in public requests and its access permissions are verified by the server-side authentication chain. You cannot use this parameter to access unauthorized tenants
parameters.help_zh: 目标租户 ID，用于公共请求的租户路由，由服务端鉴权链校验访问权限；不能据此访问未授权租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the directory. The name must be 1 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 目录名称，长度为 1–256 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 团队产品资料与操作指引
parameters.help_en: The purpose or content description of the directory. If omitted, this parameter is left empty
parameters.help_zh: 目录的用途或内容说明；省略时为空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The internal primary key of the parent directory. If this parameter is omitted or set to null, a root directory for the enterprise knowledge base is created. If this parameter is specified, a subdirectory is created. This parameter must be omitted or set to null when digital employee association or version summary configurations are included
parameters.help_zh: 父目录内部主键。省略或 null 创建企业知识库根目录；指定时创建子目录。携带数字员工关联或版本摘要配置时必须省略或为 null
parameters.name: parent_id

parameters.help_en: The path of the directory. If this parameter is omitted or set to null, the server calculates the path based on the parent directory and the name
parameters.help_zh: 目录路径；省略或 null 时由服务端根据父目录和名称计算
parameters.name: path

schema.description_en: The schema for creating an enterprise knowledge base directory

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. If the request fails, a specific business error code is returned
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功为 200；失败时为具体业务错误码

description.description_en: The description of the directory after creation. If not set, this field is empty
description.description_zh: 创建后的目录描述；未设置时为空
description.example: 团队产品资料与操作指引

directoryId.description_en: The business ID of the newly created directory. For standard enterprise roots, this ID can be used to read or update knowledge base configurations
directoryId.description_zh: 新建目录的业务 ID；普通企业根可用此标识读取或更新知识库配置

gmtCreate.description_en: The time when the directory was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
gmtCreate.description_zh: 目录创建时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒

gmtModified.description_en: The time when the directory was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
gmtModified.description_zh: 目录最后修改时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒

id.description_en: The internal primary key of the directory, which can be used as the parentId when creating a subdirectory. This is different from the business ID directoryId
id.description_zh: 目录内部主键，可作为创建子目录时的 parentId；不同于业务标识 directoryId

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful. If the request fails, the message describes the cause of the error
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success；失败时用于说明错误原因

name.description_en: The name of the directory after creation

operatingObjectName.description_en: The legacy single digital employee association field. Do not use this field to replace the mode and association list returned by GetKnowledgeBaseConfiguration
operatingObjectName.description_zh: 历史单一数字员工关联字段；不能用此字段代替 GetKnowledgeBaseConfiguration 返回的模式与关联名单

parentId.description_en: The internal primary key of the parent directory. This field is empty for enterprise root directories
parentId.description_zh: 父目录的内部主键；企业根目录为空

path.description_en: The path of the directory after creation

requestId.description_en: The request tracking ID, which can be used to troubleshoot issues for this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求追踪标识，可用于定位本次调用的问题

tenantId.description_en: The ID of the tenant to which the directory belongs

userId.description_en: The ID of the platform user who created the directory
userId.description_zh: 创建目录的平台用户 ID
